# herdsman export

<!-- Generated by make docs. Change the source it names and regenerate. -->

Copy the whole account to a new folder.

```text
usage: herdsman export <destination>

Copies the whole account to a new folder: every database, every snapshot the
records name and the rest of the state directory. Other operations wait until
it ends. The folder appears complete or not at all.

exit codes:
  0  exported
  1  refused or failed
  2  bad usage
```
